pages.title: Golem Magic — Stone Fist
pages.text: $(o)A stone fist erupts from the ground.$()

Golem magic like the exam's golem bottles: a huge stone fist bursts from the ground at your target and launches everything above it. Physical mass breaks defensive magic quickly. Three levels. Damage:
1.5× spell power within 2.2 + 0.5 × level blocks, launching targets upward.

pages.title: At a glance
pages.text: $(l)School:$() Evocation$(br)$(l)Rarity:$() Rare and up$(br)$(l)Levels:$() 3$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 55 (+15 per level)$(br)$(l)Cooldown:$() 9 s$(br)$(l)Cast:$() Instant$(br)$(l)Effect:$() 1.5x spell power within 2.2 + 0.5 x level blocks$(br)$(o)Before gear bonuses: 12.0 at level 1, 21.0 at level 3.$()
